Name: Baking Lovers Decor
Author: Kayyteee
Description:
[font=Courier New][center][size=4][b]This mod is for all the decor lovers who wants more variety of desserts and extra cuteness[/b][/size]
[size=2]
Baking Lovers Decor has over 300 new decor for you to enjoy and have fun with. Furniture includes: buildable counters (with 8 colour variations), variety of table top decors (ingredientsm tools,dishes and more), rotatable cabinets, dessert glass displays and other cute miscelaneous items. You can easily recolour item to fit your taste with Alternative textures.

You can buy the Baking Lovers Decor Catalogue at Robin and use the paint bucket from her shop to change textures.
[/size][size=2]
[b][u]Mod installation: [/u][/b]
-Download the mod and all dependencies
-Place files into your mod files
-Load the game and purchase the catalogue from robin
-Have fun!

[u][b]Compatibility:[/b][/u]
This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. This mod is not tested on mobile,
This mod is fully compatible with all other furniture mods and if there is any problem do give me a message.

Compatible with happy home designer.

[b][u]Translation:[/u][/b]
This mod is currently only in english.
I'm forever grateful if anyone is happy to translate it into another language but it isn't required.

[/size][/center][/font]
